name: Confidence Petroleum India Ltd
tagline: Vertically-integrated LPG cylinder manufacturer and auto-LPG/PNG distributor with decent 36% revenue growth and low debt, but thin returns on capital (ROCE ~9%) keep it a middling commodity-distribution story rather than a compounder.
business_overview: Confidence Petroleum manufactures LPG cylinders and distributes packed/auto LPG (brand 'Go Gas') via 15+ cylinder plants and 68+ bottling plants across 25 Indian states plus 2 facilities in Indonesia. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@nid_rockz, bullish/very-high conviction, 2026-09-13). A long-running (since 2018) but middling ValuePickr thread exists (topic search only, not resolved this pass).
fundamentals_table: 5-yr sales CAGR ~36.4%; H1 net sales +37.5% YoY to Rs 2,095 Cr
fundamentals_narrative: Revenue growth is genuinely strong (36% CAGR, accelerating H1 print) and the balance sheet is conservatively levered (Debt/EBITDA ~1.3x), but the underlying returns on capital are unremarkable - ROCE ~9% and ROE ~7% are consistent with a low-margin, capital-intensive commodity distribution business (cylinder manufacturing plus bottling) rather than one with real pricing power. At ~21x trailing earnings against sub-10% ROCE, the stock is not obviously cheap for the quality of returns on offer. No named management or structural inflection (e.g. a new PNG/CNG pivot, major contract win) was found this pass to justify a re-rating case.
